'''2011 Yavin 4 Regionals Andrew Moss LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Moss]] at [[2011 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Ten Years In the Making
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
